item.title: [SI] joint commemorative coin
item.description: joint commemorative coin Commemorative coins are identical to the general circulation €2 coin in terms of dimensions and in terms of physical properties. They have a common European side, and a national side with a motif marking an event of wider international significance or of major significance to Slovenia. They are issued only once a year, except when euro area countries opt to issue a joint commemorative coin . Commemorative coins are legal tender in all euro area countries. — Fuente: Banka Slovenije
